title: Verified QCCD Compilation
subtitle: How the compiler is built, how its output is proved correct, and how to build your own -- in Lean, in this browser

volumes.title: The machine as data
volumes.about: Devices as graphs, programmes as data, replay as a function, and the rules as statements Lean can decide.

volumes.title: Certificates and the proved checker
volumes.about: What a certificate records, what it means for one to hold, the decision procedure that settles it, and the proof that the procedure is right.

volumes.title: Semantics: which gate the pulses make
volumes.about: Exact numbers, the native pulses as matrices, u3 from two pulses, CX from one entangling pulse, stabilizer tableaux, and measurement -- without Mathlib.

volumes.title: Verify the website yourself
volumes.about: Every compiled case this site publishes, checked by you: in this page for the small ones, with the downloadable checker for the large ones.

volumes.title: Build your own verified compiler
volumes.about: A compiler for a chain of traps written in Lean and proved correct by construction; then a compiler in any language, validated by the checker; then the Compiler board.
